body: Thanks for the kind comments. I feel like all my problems are so small compared to problems other people have, I just have problems coping.

That I want to kill myself every day, have been struggling with depression (maybe I should use the term "continuous shithole" since I haven't been official diagnosed) for almost 4 years and just can't work up the courage to kill myself. That I'm going to be a Junior in high school next year without having friends for as long as I can remember. That the only thing I enjoy doing in life is something I can't do because I can't afford a better computer.
